releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Smart Reminder and Personal Calendar alarm scheduling now continues when full-screen UI permission is unavailable; Android may still restrict full-screen wake display. Existing Private Locker and Diary Lock features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 308: Note PIN prompt text now fits the actual PIN box width, with exactly 3px clear space on each inner side. The largest size that fits is selected for short, medium and long prompts; the fit recalculates after the box is displayed or resized. No PIN entry or saved data behavior changed.
